- Glass frogs have translucent skin on their undersides.
- Their hearts and other organs can be seen through the skin.

- They do so by storing most of their red blood cells in their livers.
prompt: The student wants to describe the 2022 discovery and how it works. Which choice most effectively uses relevant information from the notes to accomplish this goal?
choices: Glass frogs have translucent skin through which their hearts can be seen.
In 2022, researchers found that sleeping glass frogs become nearly transparent by storing most of their red blood cells in their livers.
Glass frogs have translucent skin on their undersides.
In 2022, researchers studied sleeping glass frogs.
expl: The discovery and the mechanism, the liver storage.
